fast_current_integral_units: pA*ms = fC; exact exponential integral per event segment
leak_integral_method: charge balance C*(V_end-V_start) minus integrated fast/APL/external current; only for postsynaptic cells with no spikes
meaningful_drive_definition: at least one delivered FAST source event and peak fast current at least 0.10 times the cell's frozen I_ref

transfer_function.bin20ms_rule: For each arrival in the 500-ms post window, replace its time by onset + 20-ms floor-bin midpoint. Preserve source row, amplitude, event count and total event impulse; align to 500-us tick.
transfer_function.single_volley_rule: Place all existing post-window arrivals at onset+100 ms, preserving source row, amplitude, event count and total event impulse. This is an extreme synchrony bound, not a proposed biological timing pattern.
transfer_function.output: first postsynaptic spike within the 500-ms post window; first tested multiplier and bracketing prior panel value, plus linear first-spike critical multiplier for frozen presynaptic events
transfer_function.scope: single-cell local replay of saved B5 delivered events, frozen C/g/rest/onset/reset/refractory/synaptic decay and 500-us tick; observed APL current included for original stage (zero before its first KC spike); no network feedback from a diagnostic postsynaptic spike
